text:
Maria: quick sync — monthly pattern hunt for incidents. can we surface top 5 recurring causes and assign owners for remediation?
Devon: +1. I pulled the last 12 postmortems, looking for repeat failure modes.
Sanjay: early flags: KV cache thrash, sudden spike OOMs on rtx-pool, autoscaler race during deploys.
Lina: noted. can you drop links to the specific PMs? easier to link to actions.
Devon: linking: GH #987 (cache-eviction), INC-234 (oom-spike-jan), GH #1012 (autoscaler-race). will add to the doc.
Maria: thank you. can we make remediation owners + deadlines today? we should avoid open action drift.
Sanjay: I can own KV cache changes — timeline: investigation by 3/30, patch + rollout canary 4/12.
Remy: I'll take autoscaler flakiness. plan: reproduce in staging by 3/28, propose fix (backoff + leader-election) by 4/8.
Lina: I'll handle OOMs on rtx-pool. short term: increase soft limits and enable per-request token caps by 3/25. long term: model quantization guidance + perf tests by 5/1.
OpsBot: reminder: add these to the incident remediation tracker: https://go.redwood/incident-tracker
Maria: please add the tracker links in this thread and update status weekly. I'll follow up in next on-call rotation. :eyes:
Devon: added actions in tracker and linked PMs. status column set to "assigned".
Sanjay: for KV cache, hypothesis: small prefix churn triggers full invalidation due to TTL bug. sharing short log snippet: ```evict loop: keys=0 size=0 ttl=-1```
Lina: thanks. can you include repro steps? On OOMs, I suspect a bad quantization config pushed by accidental CLI flag.
Sanjay: repro steps in tracker now. tests show eviction when prefix count > 512.
Remy: autoscaler notes: race happens when deploy + burst of short-lived jobs. stepping down the scale-to-zero policy prevents it. will propose config change + canary.
Devon: action item: create canary runbook for both autoscaler and cache changes. owner: Remy (autoscaler), SShaw? (cache runbook) — Maria, confirm owner for cache runbook.
Maria: SShaw is out this week; Sshah -> Sanjay can do the runbook for cache. confirmed.
Lina: cross-team dependency: infra needs to provide a staging fleet that mirrors rtx-pool spike characteristics. @Devon can you tag eng-infra?
Devon: pinged eng-infra channel and added a note in tracker for staging capacity.
Remy: estimated risk matrix added to tracker: autoscaler fix low-risk canary, KV cache medium due to potential invalidation side-effects, OOM mitigations high until perf tests done.
Maria: good. next steps: owners execute tasks, update tracker weekly, and we'll reconvene in 2 weeks for progress and to synthesize recurring themes for leadership summary.
Lina: agree. I'll put a short one-pager with suggested long-term fixes (quantize + perf harness) by 4/15.
Sanjay: tagging in PRs: I'll reference GH #1105 when I open the cache fix.
Devon: I'll consolidate the top causes and proposed fix categories (cache, autoscale, model memory) into the retro slide deck. deadline: 4/5.
Maria: perfect — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: incident tracker updated: https://go.redwood/incident-tracker/1795003210
